1981-2415-4446-8250.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-4446-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

603-5470-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-5470-6495.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat from step 2.
603-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1011-2728-4050-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4050-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4050-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

457-1409-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

7282-7826.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
7282-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {2} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1475-3967-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4659-5086-5183-6753-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6753-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-560-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-1659-2841-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-1659-2841-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3446-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5026-6790.manaNeeded: {R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
5026-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
5026-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve the copy of Reverberate, creating a copy of Reverberate targeting the original Reverberate.
Repeat step 5.

4017-4186-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-4716.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Muraganda Raceway.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Muraganda Raceway.
Repeat.
74-943-6256.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Muraganda Raceway instead.

372-3277-3563.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-3277-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2178-5256-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-5256-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-3678-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-3678-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

67-2438-2517-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2438-2517-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-1636-4117-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Visara the Dreadful does not have summoning sickness.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1636-4117-4302.description:
Activate Visara the Dreadful by tapping it, destroying another creature you control.
When the creature dies as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4050-4424-4864.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Monastery Flock, adding {U}.
When Monastery Flock dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Monastery Flock from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Monastery Flock's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1247-1506-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1506-4893.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1703-3821-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
1703-3821-5256.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Peregrine Drake's power.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {5}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

225-3078-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3078-4222.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.

305-3457-4235.notablePrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe and Seeker of Skybreak do not have summoning sickness.
305-3457-4235.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability and choose a new target for the copy.
Resolve both copies of Seeker of Skybreak's ability, untapping Seeker of Skybreak and Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any creature instead of Llanowar Tribe in step 4.
